Chapter 265: Chapter 13 Taiyang Ancient Saint, Standing Tall And Upright (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 265: Chapter 13 Taiyang Ancient Saint, Standing Tall and Upright (Please Subscribe)_3

As long as he dared to leave Mount Morality Immortal with his true form.

Whether he planned to confront the Blood Demon Sea or the Demon Saint’s Nest of the Nether Palace,

the other two sides would certainly strike against Mount Morality Immortal.

But now that threat was no longer present.

With Mu Mengting, an Ancient Saint, sitting in the Immortal Mountain,

even if three or five Ancient Saints besieged it, they wouldn’t be able to shake the foundation of the Daode Immortal Sect.

...

Thus, Mu Qingliu could take action freely and restore the prestigious name of the Daode Immortal Sect above all beings.

“Sect Master, which side do you plan to move against first?”

Mu Mengting asked in a low voice.

“Which side?”

Mu Qingliu pondered for a moment, “Let’s start with the East Sea.”

Over the past century, the development speed of Baiyu Island’s White Jade Pavilion was extremely fast, almost having unified the Eastern Sea Islands.

And that Master Yuanyang of Baiyu Island was only half an Ancient Saint; over the years, even if he had made a breakthrough, it’s impossible for him to have entered the Refining Void Period.

Given that, with Mu Qingliu’s true form plus the Taihao Immortal Mirror, they would grasp a complete victory over the enemy.

On the other hand,

should Mu Qingliu choose to make a move against the Nether Palace, the Demon Saint’s Nest, or the Blood Demon Sea first, Master Yuanyang would certainly hide upon hearing of it.

In the end, the Daode Immortal Sect, the Nether Palace, the Demon Saint’s Nest, and the Blood Demon Sea were all old adversaries.

The latter three had special trump cards, and although Mu Qingliu held the Taihao Immortal Mirror, he could only suppress them, not kill them.

Therefore, taking action against the East Sea was most in line with Mu Qingliu’s expectations.

“The East Sea.”

“That Master Yuanyang of Baiyu Island deserves to die.”

Mu Mengting nodded and said.

Initially, Master Yuanyang had destroyed his beloved Black Gauze Archipelago that he had managed for many years—this was a grudge he still remembered to this day.

“I leave the sect in your hands.”

After saying these words, Mu Qingliu’s figure vanished into the distance.

…

The East Sea.

Baiyu Island.

Hundreds of thousands of White Jade Pavilion disciples gathered on the island.

Moreover, a large number of mortals converged on Baiyu Island; though called ‘island,’ it was nearly two million li in size, equivalent to several Canglan Stars.

If not for the vastness of the Central Divine Continent, Baiyu Island should really be called Baiyu Continent.

The core area of Baiyu Island.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

Below him, several disciples were raising cultivation queries, and Lin Yuan was answering them casually.

Hundreds of years had passed, the foundation of the White Jade Pavilion had greatly increased: cultivators at the Martial Tao First Rank exceeded a hundred thousand, Second Rank surpassed ten thousand, Third Rank was more than two thousand, and there were three hundred and twenty-two individuals at the Fourth Stage Martial Tao.

There were eight cultivators at Martial Tao Fifth Stage.

It could be said that,

the White Jade Pavilion was undoubtedly the first in the Eastern Sea Islands today, and if Lin Yuan wished, uniting the Eastern Sea Islands would be a piece of cake.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something.

He looked up toward the sky.

…

On Baiyu Island,

countless disciples were either gathering together or wandering alone, studying and cultivating martial Tao techniques.

Suddenly—

Above in the Nine Heavens,

a round Immortal Mirror radiating terrifying immortal light bobbed in and out of visibility.

As the Immortal Mirror turned slightly, a beam of terrifying light descended from the Nine Heavens.

The terrifying nature of the mirror light brought even space itself to a near standstill; wherever it passed, nature’s spiritual energy dissolved into nothingness.

It was foreseeable that,

if this mirror light were to fall on Baiyu Island,

the entire island would be pierced through, this holy land of cultivation completely destroyed.

The fallout of the mirror light would lead to the death of all beings below the Ancient Saint level.

“What is that?”

“This is bad, run quickly.”

“It’s too late; we’re all going to die.”

…

Countless White Jade Pavilion disciples looked up at the sky, filled with despair.

Beneath the terrifying light of the Immortal Mirror, there was only one thought in everyone’s mind:

Death.

No matter where they ran,

it was death.

Just then,

a figure appeared above Baiyu Island.

Instantly taking on a phenomenal size, he was so tall that his height was immeasurable, his force of Taiyang so intense it was like a second sun.

The towering figure raised his hand lightly, and Baiyu Island, about the size of several Canglan Stars, was completely protected within the palm of his hand.
